import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int N = 12;
    static final int INF = 1000000009;
    static final int[] xx = {0, 1, 0, -1};
    static final int[] yy = {1, 0, -1, 0};
    
    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[N][N];
    static char[][] b = new char[N][N];
    static int sx, sy;
    static int[][] v = new int[N][N];
    static boolean[][][][][] dp = new boolean[N * 6][N][N][N][N];
    static boolean[][][][] u = new boolean[N][N][N][N];
    static int[][] g = new int[2 * N * N][2 * N * N];
    static int[] p = new int[2 * N * N];
    static boolean[] c = new boolean[2 * N * N];
    
    static class Ban {
        int x, y;
        Ban(int x, int y) {
            this.x = x;
            this.y = y;
        }
    }
    
    static void bfs(int[][] d, int sx, int sy) {
        boolean[][] c = new boolean[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                d[i][j] = INF;
            }
        }
        Queue<Ban> q = new LinkedList<>();
        c[sx][sy] = true;
        d[sx][sy] = 0;
        q.add(new Ban(sx, sy));
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            Ban t = q.poll();
            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                Ban h = new Ban(t.x, t.y);
                h.x += xx[i];
                h.y += yy[i];
                if (h.x >= 0 && h.x < n && h.y >= 0 && h.y < n && !c[h.x][h.y] && 
                    '0' <= a[h.x][h.y] && a[h.x][h.y] <= '9') {
                    c[h.x][h.y] = true;
                    d[h.x][h.y] = d[t.x][t.y] + 1;
                    q.add(h);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    
    static boolean bfs1() {
        Arrays.fill(c, false);
        Arrays.fill(p, 0);
        Queue<Integer> q = new LinkedList<>();
        c[0] = true;
        q.add(0);
        while (!q.isEmpty()) {
            int x = q.poll();
            if (x == 2 * n * n + 1)
                return true;
            for (int h = 0; h <= 2 * n * n + 1; ++h) {
                if (g[x][h] > 0) {
                    if (!c[h]) {
                        c[h] = true;
                        p[h] = x;
                        q.add(h);
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        return false;
    }
    
    static void solv() throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] line1 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(line1[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(line1[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            a[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            b[i] = br.readLine().toCharArray();
        }
        
        String[] line2 = br.readLine().split(" ");
        sx = Integer.parseInt(line2[0]);
        sy = Integer.parseInt(line2[1]);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') {
                    sx = i;
                    sy = j;
                }
            }
        }
        
        bfs(v, sx, sy);
        
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
                if ('0' <= a[i][j] && a[i][j] <= '9') {
                    dp[0][i][j][i][j] = true;
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int yt = 0; yt < t; ++yt) {
            for (int sx = 0; sx < n; ++sx) {
                for (int sy = 0; sy < n; ++sy) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                            if (!dp[yt][sx][sy][x][y])
                                continue;
                            if (v[x][y] <= yt)
                                continue;
                            for (int i = 0; i < 4; ++i) {
                                int hx = x + xx[i];
                                int hy = y + yy[i];
                                if (hx >= 0 && hx < n && hy >= 0 && hy < n && 
                                    '0' <= a[hx][hy] && a[hx][hy] <= '9') {
                                    if (v[hx][hy] >= yt + 1) {
                                        dp[yt + 1][sx][sy][hx][hy] = true;
                                    }
                                }
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int yt = 0; yt <= t; ++yt) {
            for (int sx = 0; sx < n; ++sx) {
                for (int sy = 0; sy < n; ++sy) {
                    for (int x = 0; x < n; ++x) {
                        for (int y = 0; y < n; ++y) {
                            if (dp[yt][sx][sy][x][y]) {
                                u[sx][sy][x][y] = true;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; ++x1) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; ++y1) {
                if ('0' <= a[x1][y1] && a[x1][y1] <= '9') {
                    g[0][x1 * n + y1 + 1] = a[x1][y1] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; ++x2) {
            for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; ++y2) {
                if ('0' <= b[x2][y2] && b[x2][y2] <= '9') {
                    g[n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1][2 * n * n + 1] = b[x2][y2] - '0';
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int x1 = 0; x1 < n; ++x1) {
            for (int y1 = 0; y1 < n; ++y1) {
                for (int x2 = 0; x2 < n; ++x2) {
                    for (int y2 = 0; y2 < n; ++y2) {
                        if (!('0' <= a[x1][y1] && a[x1][y1] <= '9'))
                            continue;
                        if (!('0' <= a[x2][y2] && a[x2][y2] <= '9'))
                            continue;
                        if (!u[x1][y1][x2][y2])
                            continue;
                        g[x1 * n + y1 + 1][n * n + x2 * n + y2 + 1] = INF;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        while (bfs1()) {
            int minu = INF;
            for (int i = 2 * n * n + 1; i != 0; i = p[i]) {
                minu = Math.min(minu, g[p[i]][i]);
            }
            for (int i = 2 * n * n + 1; i != 0; i = p[i]) {
                g[p[i]][i] -= minu;
                g[i][p[i]] += minu;
            }
        }
        
        int ans = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= 2 * n * n + 1; ++i) {
            ans += g[i][0];
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }
    
    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        solv();
    }
}
